ios.desc:
Stop the endless “what day works?” texts.

Whenish makes it easy to plan with friends, family, coworkers, and groups directly inside Messages. Create a poll, share dates and times, and let everyone vote on what works best — without switching apps or dealing with messy group chat back-and-forth.

Perfect for:
• Dinner plans
• Weekend trips
• Golf tee times
• Fantasy football drafts
• Birthday parties
• Happy hours
• Game nights
• Team meetups
• Study groups
• Family events

How It Works
Create a poll in seconds
Share it in iMessage
Everyone votes on dates and times
Pick the best option and lock in plans
Why People Use Whenish

• Built for iMessage
• Fast and simple to use
• No endless texting
• Great for groups of any size
• Easy date and time voting
• Clean, lightweight experience

Whether you're trying to coordinate a dinner with friends or schedule a trip with a large group, Whenish helps you find a date everyone can agree on — fast.

Download Whenish and make planning easier.

while not exactly $500/month, my side project Whenish (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whenish/id6745035749) makes me some beer money.

I made Whenish cause i was frustrated with apps taking you outside of group chats to schedule events and find out dates when people are available. Whenish is an iMessage extension app and it works pretty nicely so far.

recently got my first user feedback email which was really exciting!

hope to figure out how marketing works to get some more users and hopefully double downloads + sales next year.

quotes.text:
hey everyone! i built Whenish because it was always so difficult to figure out what date worked best with a bunch of friends in a group chat.

Whenish is an iMessage app that allows individuals to select multiple dates that work for them for an event attempting to be planned for.

i have more ideas for new features but wanted to get something out there that was usable. so far ive had good reception in my friend group chats of Whenish.

download it, give it a go, let me know what you think! this is my first app i felt ~good~ about releasing.
